_howto: Elections polled by the Vermont SOS adapter (server/src/adapters/vtsos.js). guid comes from {base}/elections/elections.json. sections are the keys of the election index whose files hold contests we track (federal = U.S. House/Senate, stateWide = Governor; add a ballot-question section here if one appears). The source reports by town and names each town's county (townDistricts), so county results are sums of towns. timeZone is the zone of lastUpdatedDate.
